study_identification_part.si4_title: Structural variability of the cerebral cortex in schizophrenia and its association with clinical symptoms

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study states clear objectives and hypotheses, and specifies the purpose of applying normative modeling to relate individual-level cortical profile deviations (via PBSI z-scores) to clinical measures. Criteria mapping: (1) Research hypotheses/questions are provided (explicit two-part hypothesis about variability and a deviant subgroup); (2) Purpose of normative modeling is described (use of z-scored PBSI to define ‘deviant’ patients and compare clinical measures).
